correctness.rationale: The exact Abel integral follows by integrating the radial energy change. The odd-part step decomposition handles either sign of switching locations and gives at most two positive radial breakpoints. Differentiation yields affine numerator on the first outer annulus and a nonzero cubic critical eliminant on the second; Rolle limits roots to two and four respectively. When absolute jumps coincide there is one break and at most two simple roots. An explicitly specified h with jumps one and five passes six disjoint interval-certified sign-change brackets, so at least six zeros exist. The upper bound forces precisely six, each simple by critical-point exhaustion. Sympy and mpmath diagnostics were executed from the actual saved verifier; finite testing is not used for the upper proof. First-order cycle persistence follows from the analytic transverse return map on regular radii.

The structural two/four root partition and cubic polynomial certificate explain the sharp count for all jump locations away from zero. This mathematical characterization is useful for selecting and verifying perturbative multicycle examples, although it deliberately does not address the unrestricted global cycle maximum.
